research_notice: Passport source review: 2026-10-06. Corrected against the official sources listed below; this is not a blanket verification of every special case or current branch schedule.

basic.name: Philippine Passport (ePassport)
basic.purpose: Proof of Philippine citizenship and identity for international travel and identification.
basic.description: A DFA-issued passport booklet with personal information, photograph and electronic security features for Filipino citizens.

eligibility.eligibility_other_conditions: Meet the applicable identity, citizenship and legal travel-restriction requirements. Foreign residence alone does not establish Philippine citizenship.
eligibility.eligibility: Filipino citizenship is required. Applicants may reside in the Philippines or abroad. Adult and minor procedures differ; legal travel restrictions are assessed under the passport law.

validity.validity: Regular passports: 10 years for applicants aged 18 or older; 5 years below 18, subject to lawful restrictions.

processing.processing_time: Published domestic periods: regular 12 working days; expedited 6 in Metro Manila or 7 outside. Confirm the release date with DFA; delivery and extra verification are separate.

fees.label: Regular Processing
fees.notes: Choose regular OR expedited; do not add both.

fees.label: Expedited Processing
fees.notes: Alternative to regular processing; availability depends on the site.

fees.label: Payment-channel charge
fees.notes: Use the amount quoted by the authorized payment channel. Do not assume one charge for every payment method.

fees.label: Optional Courier Delivery
fees.notes: Use the courier quote; no unverified fixed delivery estimate.

fees.label: Lost / damaged passport penalty
fees.notes: Additional charge for the applicable lost or damaged/mutilated application, not ordinary new applications or renewals.

content.text: Open the official portal, choose your preferred consular office, and select an available date and time.
Select NEW under Application Type and enter accurate personal information.
Pay through an authorized payment channel within the deadline shown for your booking.
Print the appointment confirmation, barcode, e-receipt, and completed application form on A4 paper.
Attend the selected DFA office at the time stated in the appointment instructions. Bring the required packet and supporting documents.
Present your documents, check the encoded personal information, and complete photo, fingerprint and digital-signature capture.

steps.title: Claim your passport or receive delivery

content.text: Choose office pickup or available courier delivery. For pickup, bring the claim stub, official receipt and current/old passport for cancellation where applicable. A representative may need authorization or SPA and a valid ID.

content.text: At passport.gov.ph select RENEWAL, choose your consular office, date and time.
For adult electronic passports. Older non-electronic passports and special cases follow different supporting-document requirements.
Complete your personal information, select the processing option, and pay through an authorized channel.

steps.title: Print the packet and prepare your documents

content.text: Print the confirmation packet, application form, confirmation slip and receipt on A4 paper.
An extra primary ID is not listed as a universal core requirement for ordinary adult ePassport renewal. Name changes and citizenship cases may require additional evidence.
Follow your appointment arrival instructions. Present documents for verification, then complete photo, fingerprints and signature capture.
Keep your stamped claim stub for pickup or arrange available door-to-door delivery.

steps.title: Check the procedure for your lost or damaged passport

content.text: Both valid and expired lost ePassports require a police report and notarized loss affidavit, subject to applicable exceptions. A copy of the lost ePassport affects the additional evidence needed.
Bring an affidavit explaining the damage and surrender the damaged passport.
Confirm the applicable application category and any additional verification period with DFA. Do not assume all expired losses follow the new-application route or a fixed clearing time.
These are case-specific additions, not a complete substitute for the applicable basic application requirements.

research_notes: Review scope: regular Philippine passports and the four listed scenarios. Supporting-document examples are not an exhaustive treatment of all citizenship, custody, adoption or name-change cases.
Philippine citizenship is required; the original foreign-resident heading and blanket clean-record condition were removed.

Accepted-ID list follows the reviewed Annex F. PWD ID, iDOLE and unspecified PNP/Seaman documents are not assumed accepted from the earlier list. This does not establish that all omitted documents are rejected. Confirm updated postal-card acceptance directly.

Late-registration route: additional accepted ID OR two supporting documents. The extra ID must not be reused from the basic identity requirement; the current readiness engine must enforce this distinction before automated scoring.
Ordinary adult electronic-passport renewal does not universally require another primary ID. Non-electronic renewal is outside that scenario.
Police report requirement for lost valid AND expired ePassports follows the newer renewal annex. Clearing time is not asserted because older guidance and newer annexes differ.
Processing periods are from an older official domestic charter, not a guaranteed current SLA. The appointment receipt/release advice controls. Payment-channel and courier charges remain variable.

Only source-backed Malolos and NCR North are selected as nearby candidates, not a distance-ranked nearest-office list. Current availability and hours require appointment-site confirmation. Marilao and Fairview claims were not confirmed.

DFA annexes mirrored by foreign posts were used for national document requirements only; overseas fees and processing times were not imported. Direct access to several OCA pages was blocked; indexed official publications were used.
The supplied September 2026 label is not retained as a verification timestamp. No automatic verified badge is set.
